secondBrain.title: Export
secondBrain.intro: Writes a folder of linked Markdown files (an index, one card per document, concepts, your notes and highlights) that Claude Code or any agent can read. Nothing is sent anywhere: the export is local and your originals are only read.

previous.title: Update an earlier export
previous.hint: Pick one to reuse its selection, options and folder. Only the generated parts that changed are rewritten and what you edited by hand is kept.

selection.title: Which documents
selection.foldersHint: A folder includes everything below it. Excluded folders never enter an export.
selection.empty: Choose a project, a folder, a tag, a cluster or some documents to export.

options.title: Options
options.cited: Include the works cited by the selection
options.citedHint: Adds the library documents the selection cites.
options.sourcesHint_none: Cards only: no reference to the original files.
options.sourcesHint_paths: Writes the full paths of the original files on this computer (they include your user and folder names) so an agent can open them. Nothing is copied. Choose this only if you are happy for whoever reads the export to see those paths.
options.sourcesHint_copies: Copies the files into the export (the originals are only read). It can take a lot of space: above 1 GiB you are asked to confirm.

destination.title: Where to write
destination.hint: Choose a folder with the folder dialog. The export goes into a new subfolder with the name below, or updates an earlier export there.
destination.dialogTitle: Choose where to write the export
destination.pickAgain: For safety, choose the folder again: the app only writes to folders you picked in this session.
destination.folderNameHint: Without \ / : * ? " < > | and not ending in a dot or space.
destination.folderInvalid: This is not a valid folder name.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.missingValue_one: {{count}} document has no file on disk (its card is written, the file is not copied)
estimate.missingValue_other: {{count}} documents have no file on disk (their cards are written, the files are not copied)
estimate.aiDisabled_one: {{count}} selected document is in a folder not enabled for AI. Exporting it will ask for your confirmation.
estimate.aiDisabled_other: {{count}} selected documents are in folders not enabled for AI. Exporting them will ask for your confirmation.
estimate.tokensTip: How much text an AI assistant would read to read the whole export. It usually needs only part of it, starting from the index.

target.new: {{name}} does not exist yet: it will be created.
target.empty: {{name}} is empty: the export will be written there.
target.previous-export: {{name}} holds an earlier export (last on {{when}}): it will be updated in place.
target.not-empty: {{name}} already has other files and is not an export of this library. Nothing is overwritten: choose another folder or name.
target.other-library: {{name}} is an export of another library. Choose another folder or name.
target.edited_one: {{count}} file has a generated section you edited by hand: it is kept as it is.
target.edited_other: {{count}} files have a generated section you edited by hand: they are kept as they are.

conflict.busy: Another export is still running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
conflict.not-empty: This folder already has other files and is not an export of this library, so nothing was written. Choose another folder or name.
conflict.other-library: This folder is an export of another library, so nothing was written. Choose another folder or name.
conflict.inside-library: This folder is inside the library folder, so nothing was written. Choose a folder outside the library: an export must not be mixed with your documents.

confirm.title: Please confirm
confirm.bodyCopy: The copies of the original files take about {{size}}. Make sure the destination has enough free space. Copy them anyway?
confirm.footer_one: There is {{count}} document not enabled for Claude: once exported, anyone who opens the folder with an AI assistant can read it.
confirm.footer_other: There are {{count}} documents not enabled for Claude: once exported, anyone who opens the folder with an AI assistant can read them.

result.cancelled: The export was cancelled. The files already written stay: run it again to complete them.
result.keptHint: Files whose generated section you edited, or copies that are your own files: they were not overwritten
result.copyErrorsHint: These source files could not be copied. Run the export again to retry them.
result.orphanedHint: Cards of documents that left the selection are not deleted: the index lists them as no longer exported.

errors.noModel: The network model is not built yet, so clusters cannot be exported. Build it in the Network section or remove the clusters.
errors.tooMany: The selection holds too many documents. Narrow it down and try again.

refs.intro: Writes one file with the references of the selection, with the citation keys of Settings › Library. An existing file is never overwritten: the name gets a number.
refs.copied: BibTeX references copied to the clipboard ({{count}}).
refs.copyNote: Only for a project or for chosen documents.
